**VERDICT: REJECT**

The proposed value 257/78125 is not the minimum, because a valid construction gives a smaller density.

**Errors in the proposed solution**

The formula Σ_{I∈Ind(F)}(Σ_{i∈I}λ_i)^8 overcounts. A set of 8 vertices with support J (the parts it meets) is counted once for every independent set I ⊇ J, not once in total. The correct count needs inclusion–exclusion over supports, so the proposed S(C₅, λ) is not the right functional.

**A better construction**

Take G to be the blow-up of C₅ in which each part is a clique and each pair of consecutive parts is joined completely, with no edges between non-consecutive parts. Then:

- Any independent set takes at most one vertex per part and uses pairwise non-consecutive parts. C₅ has independence number 2, so α(G) = 2 < 3.
- A clique uses a set of parts forming a clique of C₅, so its support is a single part or two consecutive parts.

With parts of size n/5, the number of 8-cliques is asymptotically

(n⁸/8!) · [5·(2/5)⁸ − 5·(1/5)⁸] = (n⁸/8!) · 1275/5⁸.

Here (2/5)⁸ = 256/5⁸ and (1/5)⁸ = 1/5⁸, so the bracket is (1280 − 5)/5⁸ = 1275/390625.

Since C(n,8) ~ n⁸/8!, the ratio tends to 1275/390625 = 51/15625 ≈ 0.003264.

The proposed answer is 1285/390625 ≈ 0.003290, which is larger. So 257/78125 cannot be the minimum. The true value is at most 51/15625, and the balanced blow-up may not be optimal, so I have not determined the exact limit.

CONFIDENCE: 4
